description: Record how a confirmed booking went: completed when the visit happened, no_show when the person didn't come. Cancels its pending reminder. To cancel or move a booking, use replo_bookings_cancel or replo_bookings_reschedule. For multi-step Replo work, read the replo skill (call skills with name "replo").

status.description: completed: the visit happened; no_show: the visitor didn't come
